definition_quote.value: The integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health through the provision of nutrition care services.

license_type_structure.quote: LICENSED DIETITIAN/NUTRITIONIST. A person licensed under this chapter. TEMPORARILY LICENSED DIETITIAN/NUTRITIONIST. A person temporarily licensed under this chapter.

provisional_license_available.quote: A temporary license to practice as a dietitian/nutritionist may be issued by the board upon the filing of an application and submission of evidence of successful completion of education requirements specified in Section 34-34A-7.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A temporary license shall expire one year from the date of issuance.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: DIETETIC TECHNICIAN. A person who is trained to perform specific dietetic functions of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist as defined by this chapter under the direct supervision of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist.

alternative_credential_pathways.quote: shall maintain membership in one of the following organizations: American Institute of Nutrition (AIN), American Society for Clinical Nutrition (ASCN), American Board of Nutrition (ABN).

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: LICENSE. An authorization from a member state to do one of the following: a. Engage in the practice of dietetics, including medical nutrition therapy.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: recommend appropriate nutritional intake including enteral and parenteral nutrition.

physician_referral_required.quote: Dietitians/nutritionists may offer advice and counsel on dietetics and nutrition as adjunct medical therapy when advice and counsel is given upon referral or directive of a licensed physician.

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: a person licensed to practice dietetics/nutrition or to provide nutritional care services shall not diagnose, treat, or prescribe for any human illness, injury, disease, impairment, or infirmity, or otherwise engage in the practice of medicine

telehealth_practice_authorized.quote: PRACTICE OF DIETETICS. The synthesis and application of dietetics, primarily for the provision of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, in person or via telehealth

direct_supervision_defined.quote: DIETETIC TECHNICIAN. A person who is trained to perform specific dietetic functions of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist as defined by this chapter under the direct supervision of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist.

value: Student in approved educational program (under supervision)
Armed forces, public health service, Veterans Administration, other federal government employees
Duly licensed health professionals (when incidental to their profession)

exempt_professions_list.quote: This chapter does not prevent or restrict the practice, services, or activities of: (1) A dietetic technician... (2) A student enrolled in an approved educational program... (3) A dietitian/nutritionist who is serving in the armed forces or the public health services... (4) A duly licensed health professional... (5) A government employee... (6) Any person, including hospital food service managers/directors

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A dietitian/nutritionist who is serving in the armed forces or the public health services of the United States or is employed by the Veterans Administration or other federal government agencies or the cooperative extension system from engaging in the practice of dietetics/nutrition provided such practice is related to such service or employment.

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: Any person who provides weight control services provided the program has been reviewed by a dietitian/nutritionist as defined in this chapter and consultation is available from a dietitian/nutritionist.

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter is intended to prohibit any person who does not hold himself or herself out to be a dietitian or nutritionist from furnishing general nutritional information on food, food materials, or dietary supplements or from engaging in the explanation to customers about foods or food products in connection with marketing and distribution of those products

interstate_compact_member.quote: The purpose of this compact is to facilitate interstate practice of dietetics with the goal of improving public access to dietetics services.

compact_privilege_jurisprudence_requirem.quote: Meet any jurisprudence requirements established by the remote state in which the licensee is seeking a compact privilege

protected_titles.quote: the word "dietitian," "dietician," "nutritionist," "registered dietitian," "registered dietician," or the letters "D," "R.D.," or any other words, letters, abbreviations, or ensignia indicating or implying that the person is a dietitian, nutritionist, or registered dietitian

nutrition_assessment_includes_biochemica.quote: NUTRITIONAL ASSESSMENT. The evaluation of the nutritional needs of individuals and groups based upon appropriate biochemical, anthropometric, physical, and dietary data
